data: Which of the lines representing the progressions start closest to 0 on the y-axis?

The question asks which line starts closest to 0 on the y-axis. From the analysis of the figure, the y-axis represents the popularity scores, and the x-axis represents the progression type. The three lines represent Arithmetic Progression, Geometric Progression, and Harmonic Progression, respectively. 

Looking at the starting points of these lines, the line for Harmonic Progression appears to start closest to 0 on the y-axis compared to the other two lines. Therefore, the answer is the line representing Harmonic Progression.
